sources.label: CADC August 2026 ATB Financial bank confirmation (newest as of 2026-09-29)

reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API listed an August 2026 bank confirmation uploaded 2026-09-01. The ATB Financial form confirms CAD 1,820,785.35 in a Business Growth Plus deposit as of 2026-08-31. The single disclosed reserve asset is Canadian-dollar cash at the named bank. The form is not an accountant's opinion or audit and does not state CADC circulation or reconcile liabilities; account number, account legal safeguards, and withdrawal terms remain undisclosed. Pre-expiry re-check 2026-09-29: the issuer API still lists CADC_Bank_Attestation_Aug_2026.pdf (uploaded 2026-09-01) as the newest entry and the transparency page adds nothing newer, so the composition remains as at 2026-08-31. Monthly uploads from January 2025 through August 2026 landed between day 1 and day 16 of the following month, so the September 2026 confirmation is expected in early-to-mid October 2026. No live adapter snapshot landed this cycle; the configured adapter is an on-chain Ethereum totalSupply liveness probe whose contract remains readable over public RPC, so the silence is not attributable to the issuer source.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: ATB Financial bank confirmation for PayTrie AB Inc as listed in Loon's August 2026 attestation API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified. The confirmation does not establish CADC liability coverage, account legal safeguards, or withdrawal terms.
